heroBody.en: A portfolio of iOS apps I conceived, designed, and built independently. Each work begins with a real user need and evolves into a product with clear utility, visual intent, and a memorable point of view.
heroBody.zh: 這裡收錄我獨立構思、設計與開發的 iOS 作品。每一個 app 都從真實需求出發，並在功能、視覺語言與使用情境之間，建立清楚而有記憶點的產品表達。

sortNote.zh: 依照目前下載受歡迎程度排序。

noLanguages.zh: 找不到符合的語言，請試試其他名稱。

languageHelp.zh: 這裡切換的是網站語言；App 或遊戲支援的語言，請以 App Store 說明為準。

loadError.en: This language could not be loaded. Please try again.
loadError.zh: 暫時無法載入這個語言，請再試一次。

steamDescription.zh: 以酒吧為背景的文字戀愛遊戲。對話選項會影響故事走向，可用存檔回到不同分支。
steamDescription.en: A romance game set in a bar. Dialogue choices lead to different story branches, which you can revisit using saved games.

title.zh: 複利計算器-財務自由實現工具

description.en: An advanced finance utility for compound growth, DCA, loans, retirement planning, and inflation-aware decisions, designed to make long-term planning easier to compare.
description.zh: 進階財務試算工具，整合複利、定期定額、貸款、退休與通膨情境，幫助使用者以更清楚、更貼近現實條件的方式思考長期金錢決策。

highlight.en: Highlight: makes complex financial logic more visual, lucid, and approachable without losing decision depth.
highlight.zh: 亮點：將複雜財務邏輯轉譯為清楚、視覺化且更容易反覆使用的決策介面。

description.en: An 18+ romance game set inside a mixology lab, blending character chemistry, emotional tension, atmospheric scenes, and branching progression.
description.zh: 以調酒研究室為背景的 18 禁戀愛遊戲，結合角色互動、情感敘事、場景氛圍與分支推進，讓曖昧、張力與想像力慢慢發酵。

highlight.en: Highlight: brings character allure, narrative tension, and adult romantic mood into a memorable interactive experience.
highlight.zh: 亮點：以成人向戀愛遊戲為定位，整合角色魅力、敘事張力與更鮮明的情境氛圍。

description.en: A clean, zero-ad drawing tool for events, classrooms, parties, and list-based selections, with a simple flow that makes quick decisions feel smoother and more polished.
description.zh: 乾淨、直覺、零廣告的抽獎工具，適用於活動、課堂、聚會與名單抽選情境，支援名單整理與即時抽選，讓短暫流程也能有節奏與完成度。

highlight.en: Highlight: brings clarity, trust, and a small sense of ceremony to an everyday utility.
highlight.zh: 亮點：以輕盈俐落的互動節奏，讓工具型 app 兼具實用性、可信度與一點舞台感。

title.zh: 幣圈神器-加密貨幣&區塊鏈學習字典

description.en: A bilingual learning app for blockchain basics and crypto investment research, combining glossary lookup, lessons, quizzes, and learning paths to build understanding step by step.
description.zh: 涵蓋區塊鏈入門與加密投資研究的雙語學習工具，結合名詞查詢、課程文章、測驗與學習路線，幫助使用者從基礎概念逐步建立研究能力。

highlight.en: Highlight: translates a complex financial frontier into a searchable, saveable, and approachable mobile reference.
highlight.zh: 亮點：將陌生的金融新知轉譯為可搜尋、可收藏、也更容易持續閱讀的行動學習工具。

description.en: A wellness app for daily supplement routines, blending intake logs, history tracking, educational content, and profile flows into a kinder self-care experience.
description.zh: 以每日保健品管理為核心，結合服用紀錄、歷史追蹤、知識整理與個人頁面，協助使用者把健康提醒整理成更穩定、更溫柔的生活習慣。

highlight.en: Highlight: makes everyday health tracking softer, clearer, and easier to return to.
highlight.zh: 亮點：以柔和清楚的互動語氣，讓日常保健追蹤更容易被理解、記住與持續。

description.en: A gentle dream-journaling app for capturing fragile images after waking, with quick entry, voice input, mood reflection, favorites, and reminders.
description.zh: 療癒系夢境記錄 app，支援快速記夢、語音輸入、情緒整理、收藏回顧與提醒功能，讓醒來後快消散的畫面被更安靜、更有秩序地留下。

highlight.en: Highlight: organizes dream writing, emotional reflection, and recall into a quiet and sustainable ritual.
highlight.zh: 亮點：將夢境書寫、情緒辨識與個人回顧整理成溫柔而可持續的日常儀式。

description.en: Bring tasks, daily schedules, focus timing, and progress review together. Editable task breakdowns use on-device keyword rules and templates to turn goals into practical daily actions.
description.zh: 整合任務庫、每日排程、專注計時與進度回顧，透過裝置內的關鍵字規則與範本提供可編輯的任務拆解，協助把目標整理成可開始、可追蹤的日常行動。

highlight.en: Highlight: connects planning, focus, and reflection with on-device storage, reusable workflows, and complete backups.
highlight.zh: 亮點：串起每日規劃、專注與回顧，資料保存在裝置上，支援常用流程與完整備份。

description.en: A themed app combining industry guidance with multi-role diaries for Taiwan's nightlife PR culture, supporting both cultural understanding and personal record-keeping.
description.zh: 結合產業介紹與個人紀錄的主題型 app，從台灣酒店文化出發，延伸到客人、小姐／男模與經紀的多角色日記，兼具知識整理與日常管理用途。

highlight.en: Highlight: turns a niche subject into an informative, atmospheric, and practical mobile product.
highlight.zh: 亮點：將少見產業題材轉化為有故事感、資訊性與實用價值的行動作品。

description.en: Plan a room with visual previews, material choices, and itemized budget estimates. Start from room templates and explore floors, walls, furniture, and lighting for early design discussions.
description.zh: 把空間預覽、材料選擇與預算整理放在一起，從客廳、臥室或工作區模板開始，調整地板、牆面、家具與燈光，整理能和家人或設計師討論的初步方案。

highlight.en: Highlight: brings room styling and budget planning together, with offline tools that make home design ideas easier to explore.
highlight.zh: 亮點：結合空間搭配與預算明細，支援離線規劃，讓居家設計想法更容易具體呈現。

title.zh: 股神養成：台美股模擬交易

description.en: Practice with virtual cash using Taiwan end-of-day data and U.S. closing-price and custom-price simulations. Keep order notes, review holdings, and explore finance terms and risk concepts without placing real trades.
description.zh: 用虛擬資金練習台美股交易，結合台股盤後資料、美股每日收盤價與自訂價格模擬、下單筆記與持倉回顧，並提供金融名詞及風險觀念，協助新手循序學習。

highlight.en: Highlight: connects paper orders, trading notes, and portfolio reviews in one workspace, with separate TWD and USD accounts.
highlight.zh: 亮點：把模擬下單、交易理由與結果回顧放在同一個工作台，台幣與美元帳戶分開管理。

description.en: A cozy pet-raising game where feeding, walks, chats, and work shape your pig's personality. After seven days of growth, choose to finish the generation or keep spending time together; collections and resources carry over.
description.zh: 透過餵食、散步、聊天與打工，慢慢塑造小豬個性的療癒養成遊戲。完成七天成長後，可以自行選擇結算或繼續陪伴，迎接下一代時保留收藏與資源。

highlight.en: Highlight: explore five personality paths, unlock 100 pig cards through gameplay, and revisit or share the endings you collect.
highlight.zh: 亮點：探索五種個性路線，透過遊戲條件收集 100 張小豬卡，收藏、重讀與分享不同的陪伴結局。

description.en: A private notebook for career conversations, bringing together meeting preparation, contacts, conversation notes, and follow-up reminders to keep insights and next steps organized.
description.zh: 為求職與職場交流打造的私人手帳，整合會前準備、聯絡人整理、對話筆記與後續提醒，把每次交流的重點與下一步清楚留下。

highlight.en: Highlight: connects relationship context, conversation insights, and follow-up actions, with on-device storage, backup and restore, and support for 20 languages.
highlight.zh: 亮點：串起人脈背景、對話洞見與跟進行動，資料儲存在裝置上，支援備份還原與 20 種語言。

description.en: A visual learning guide for semiconductor beginners, combining 24 introductory lessons, interactive process diagrams, company profiles, a glossary, and quizzes to explain chips and the industry behind them.
description.zh: 為半導體初學者打造的圖解學習工具，結合 24 堂入門課、互動製程示意、公司檔案、術語字典與小測驗，逐步理解晶片原理與產業分工。

highlight.en: Highlight: connects technical concepts with industry roles through interactive diagrams, with 20 languages, offline lessons, study notes, and quiz review.
highlight.zh: 亮點：以互動圖解連結技術概念與產業脈絡，支援 20 種語言、離線教材，以及學習筆記與錯題複習。

title.zh: 哩程管家：信用卡換機票試算

description.en: Compare published award charts, mile-purchase costs, and Taiwan credit-card transfer terms. Factor in your route, cabin, and existing balances to estimate the points, spending, and time needed for a redemption.
description.zh: 整合航空獎勵機票票表、買哩程成本與台灣信用卡轉點條件，依航線、艙等及現有哩程，比較兌換所需的點數、消費金額與累積時間。

highlight.en: Highlight: brings airline miles and bank points into one planning tool, with side-by-side comparisons and 20 languages to help track redemption goals.
highlight.zh: 亮點：把航空哩程與銀行點數放在一起試算，支援多方案並排比較與 20 種語言，協助規劃換票目標。

title.zh: 我決定自己的未來-大學選系指南

description.en: Explore universities and majors in Taiwan and the United States with interest quizzes, program learning maps, saved notes, and side-by-side comparisons that help students and families plan their next steps.
description.zh: 陪伴學生與家長探索台灣及美國的大學與科系，整合興趣測驗、校系學習地圖、收藏筆記與並排比較，把選校選系整理成清楚的下一步。

highlight.en: Highlight: connects fields of study, coursework, and career paths using dated source information, with support for 25 interface languages.
highlight.zh: 亮點：將學習方向、修課內容與職涯資訊連結起來，資料標示年度與來源，支援 25 種介面語言。

title.zh: 研究生讀 Paper 神器

description.en: Build a personal research library from PDFs, images, and scans. Keep originals and notes on your device, with local text extraction, rule-based reading breakdowns, and paragraph translation on supported systems.
description.zh: 匯入 PDF、圖片與掃描文件，建立保存在裝置上的個人文獻庫，結合文字擷取、閱讀拆解與研究筆記，並在支援的系統上提供逐段翻譯，協助整理論文與研究想法。

highlight.en: Highlight: read documents beside your notes on iPad, search extracted text, copy citation formats, and export complete library backups for easier research review.
highlight.zh: 亮點：在 iPad 並排閱讀原文與筆記，支援擷取文字搜尋、引用格式複製與完整文獻備份，讓閱讀紀錄更容易整理與回查。

description.en: Explore the financial industry through introductory lessons in Traditional Chinese and English, quizzes, a Taiwan institution directory, and information on roles, skills, and qualifications.
description.zh: 金融產業與職涯學習指南，整合繁中與英文入門課程、測驗、台灣金融機構名錄及職務與證照資訊，協助探索金融工作的內容與所需技能。

highlight.en: Highlight: compare institutions using dated sources and keep notes, bookmarks, and learning progress; optional Pro adds corporate credit practice with fictional cases.
highlight.zh: 亮點：依機構類型查詢與比較附來源的資料，保存筆記、收藏與學習進度；選用 Pro 可透過虛構案例練習企業授信決策。

description.en: Explore brand and founder stories, classic designs, materials, and craftsmanship through 50 brand profiles, 30 classic product families, 15 introductory lessons, a glossary, and quizzes.
description.zh: 從品牌與創辦人的故事認識經典設計、材質與工藝，收錄 50 個品牌、30 個經典產品家族、15 堂入門課及詞彙與測驗，讓時尚知識更容易循序學習。

highlight.en: Highlight: connects sourced references, side-by-side comparisons, saved notes, and quiz review in 10 languages, with on-device learning records and no account required.
highlight.zh: 亮點：結合附來源的品牌資料、並排比較、收藏筆記與錯題複習，提供 10 種語言；個人學習紀錄保存在裝置上，不需註冊帳號。

description.en: Organise tasks, focus timers, medication records and daily notes. Keep separate care records, appointments and visit questions, with on-device storage, export and restore.
description.zh: 整合任務、專注計時、用藥與每日紀錄，可為不同受照顧者分別整理觀察、預約及就診問題，資料保存在裝置上並支援匯出與還原。

highlight.en: Highlight: No account required, with ten interface languages. Keep personal and care records separate; Pro adds reusable routines, saved timer settings and extra trends.
highlight.zh: 亮點：不需帳號，支援 10 種介面語言；可分開整理個人與照護紀錄，Pro 提供可重用流程、計時設定及額外趨勢。
